
{{alias}}( value )
    Tests if an input value is an compare instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Value to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating if an input value is an compare instance.

    Examples
    --------
    > var Compare = {{alias:@stdlib/plot/vega/mark/compare}};
    > var v = new Compare({ 'field': 'amount' });
    > var bool = {{alias}}( v )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( {} )
    false

    --------
